name: Salon Angel
tagline:
A little change.
A beautiful feeling.
about: A hair salon on Lee Highway in Fairfax. From balayage to a fresh haircut, customers celebrate the color, the attention to detail, and the warm welcome.

reviews.author: Bb B.
reviews.text: My hair looks so soft, shiny, and healthy, and the color came out gorgeous!

reviews.author: Karima D.
reviews.text: The salon is so chic, stylish, and welcoming, and everyone was super friendly.

reviews.author: Zury V.
reviews.text: The staff made me feel so comfortable and confident throughout the entire process.

reviews.author: Nicci N.
reviews.text: Angel did an amazing job with my balayage and haircut! This is hands down the best hair color and style I’ve ever had.
